summary: Anthropic announced a global strategic alliance with KPMG to embed Claude across KPMG's Digital Gateway platform and give all 276,000+ KPMG employees access to Claude, including new tax, legal, cybersecurity and private-equity-focused offerings.

mechanisms.reason: Rolling Claude out to a workforce of 276,000+ plus embedding it in a client-facing platform substantially increases the number of users and tasks generating inference calls.
mechanisms.quote: every one of KPMG's 276,000+ employees globally will gain access to Claude

mechanisms.reason: Claude Cowork and Managed Agents are being embedded into KPMG's core work platform to let agents build and run tools that previously required manual multi-tool workflows.
mechanisms.quote: With Cowork and Managed Agents integrated in Digital Gateway, that same capability takes minutes. This is a totally different way of working.

categories.reason: The Digital Gateway platform carrying this large new inference workload is built on Microsoft Azure, tying incremental usage to hyperscale cloud infrastructure.
categories.quote: Digital Gateway is KPMG's main platform for client work—built on Microsoft Azure

notable_reason: A frontier-scale enterprise deployment (276,000+ employees, plus a dedicated private-equity partner channel) is a meaningful data point on enterprise inference demand growth for a major professional services firm.
